newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends down, eyes on small stocks.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends down, eyes on small stocks.

text.p: The Jakarta index closed down on Wednesday, with the market focused on small stocks amid a lack of strong fresh market factors, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 1.13 points, or 0.17 percent, to 650.88 points after touching a high of 653.29 points.
Total turnover was around 533.78 billion rupiah compared with 303 billion rupiah on Tuesday.
Decliners led gainers by 69 to 43 with 69 issues unchanged.
"Trading volume was surprsingly high, but most of the actively traded stocks were small-capitalised ones," one broker with a Hong Kong brokerage firm said.
